note: No new external assets. The world is built entirely from parts, Roblox 2022 materials, SurfaceGuis and terrain created in code. Particle textures are Roblox built-ins (rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds, smoke_main.dds, sparkles_main.dds). The only marketplace assets used are the five stage ambience sounds already in the game (Stages.<StageId>.Ambience, already listed in RF.Credits), re-used by CL.LobbyAmbience as positional loops at each arena.
